'''Warped skeletons''' are monsters that appear in the fifth section of [[The Shadow Reef]]. 

Similar to [[Edimmu]], warped skeletons are capable of healing through their magic attacks, recovering roughly 25% of the damage dealt onto the player, ignoring any damage reduction abilities or effects. They are also capable of dealing devastating melee attacks, much like the other skeletons encountered in the raid. Despite possessing magic attacks, they can only attack within melee distance. 

As undead, they are susceptible to the effects of the [[salve amulet]] and its [[salve amulet (e)|enhanced version]], the [[Undead Slayer]] perk and effects of the [[Undead Slayer (ability)|Undead Slayer]] [[ability]].
